name: Dick Erixon - § 33/2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text: ‘calls on the Court to evaluate its overall composition and provide this analysis to the Council and the Member States, in order to ensure that gender balance is appropriately considered in future nomination processes; reiterates its call for Member States to propose candidates of different genders, aiming for a more balanced and representative composition of the Court;’
